observations: Photo 0 shows a gas cooker with 4 gas burners on top (arranged in a 2x2 style) and visible control knobs on the front panel.
Photo 1 shows the same cooker from a different angle with 4 gas burners lit (blue flames visible). It also shows 2 electric hotplate rings in the middle.
Photo 2 shows the front/side of the cooker; the oven door and front control area are visible, but the oven interior is not shown.

identity.kind: gas cooker with 4 gas burners + 2 electric hotplates (6 cooking zones total)

claims.claim: 4 Gas cooker and 2 burner making 6 burner in total.
claims.evidence: Photos show 4 gas burners plus 2 electric hotplate rings (photo 1). The seller’s wording says '2 burner' but the 2 middle elements appear to be electric hotplates, not gas burners.
Photo 1 shows gas burners lighting with blue flames, but there is no proof of oven heating performance, thermostat accuracy, or that all elements work under normal load.

risks.risk: Oven may not heat properly (weak burner, faulty thermostat, or igniter issues). Photos do not show the oven in operation.
risks.proof: A short video clip of the oven turned on (set to a temperature) with the oven burner/heat visibly working and a thermometer reading after a few minutes.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: oven not reliably working (discounted accordingly).

risks.risk: Electric hotplates may be faulty or uneven heating (photos only show gas flames; hotplates are not demonstrated).
risks.proof: A short video clip turning on each hotplate ring and showing it heating (glowing/temperature rise) for a few minutes.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: electric hotplates not working.

risks.risk: Gas safety issues (leaks, burner alignment, faulty regulator/valves). Photos cannot confirm leak-free operation.
risks.proof: A leak test demonstration (soap-bubble test at connections) and confirmation of stable flame without flicker when the knob is adjusted.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: needs servicing for safe gas use.

risks.risk: Condition issues not visible (dents, rust, missing knobs/parts, worn burner caps).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of burner caps, knob faces, and the oven door seal/gasket; plus a photo of the rating plate/model label.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: cosmetic wear and possible missing/weak parts.

proof_requests: Video of oven heating (set temperature) showing it actually heats for several minutes.
Video of both electric hotplates turning on and heating (one by one).
Leak test at gas inlet/regulator connections (soap-bubble test) and flame stability when knobs are adjusted.
Clear photo of the rating plate/model label (for exact model and correct parts).
Close-ups of burner caps, knobs, and oven door seal/gasket.
response.reason: The photos confirm a cooker with 4 gas burners and 2 electric hotplates, and gas flames can be seen, but the seller’s 'all working perfectly' cannot be verified remotely for the oven and electric elements. Missing decisive proof prevents confident worst-case pricing.
